graphics_menu.doc: The Graphics settings page (M1-UI-10; docs/kb/tech/graphics_settings.md, 'The Graphics menu'). Rects are top-left x, y, w, h at the 1920 x 1080 reference. 'page' are MenuPage metrics. value_keys: loc key per string option of graphics_presets.json 'settings' (booleans use on_key / off_key; numbers print as they are, except percent_settings, shown as a percentage, and multiplier_settings, shown with a times sign). The rows are the preset, then every setting in graphics_presets.json order.

apply.doc: M1-UI-11: a preset change with GraphicsRuntime armed spawns the resident shader warm-up (a frame can freeze 0.5-1.7 s), so the page fades to an opaque veil over fade_out_sec, lets settle_frames opaque frames draw, selects the preset, holds card_key until the warm-up is done (max_hold_sec is a safety net), then fades back over fade_in_sec. Input is blocked throughout. card.rect is x, y, w, h at 1920 x 1080.
